scenario.description: Nora is organizing a family oral-history recording for her grandmother's eightieth birthday and must make the final call about the recording format, session length, venue schedule, and accessibility plan after checking in with three relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family wants to record stories from Grandma for her eightieth birthday.
shared_context.S2: Nora is coordinating the recording session and will make the final plan.
shared_context.S3: The session could be recorded as audio or video, and it could be held at home or in a quiet community room.
shared_context.S4: Nora's usual planning routine is to check with each person before she confirms a family event.
shared_context.S5: The final plan needs a definite session length, place and time, recording format, and way for relatives to follow along.

PF1.text: Grandma told Caleb that she will participate only in an audio recording, not video, and that the interview itself must be no longer than 45 minutes; this has not reached the rest of the family.

PF2.text: Mei spoke with the community librarian, who confirmed that the quiet recording room is reserved for the family on Saturday, November 6, 2027, from 14:00 to 15:30; she has not shared the confirmation yet.

PF3.text: Omar has hearing loss and needs a printed transcript in at least 18-point type during the session so he can follow the conversation.

acceptance_conditions: The recording must be audio only.
The interview must be exactly 45 minutes or shorter.
The session must use the confirmed community recording room.
The session must occur on November 6, 2027, from 14:00 to 15:30.
A printed transcript in exactly 18-point type must be arranged.
A commitment to prepare the large-print transcript must be included.
Caleb's report of Grandma's audio-only and 45-minute limit must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C4: decisions['date'] == 'Saturday, November 6, 2027' and decisions['start_time'] == '14:00' and decisions['end_time'] == '15:30'
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Omar' and '18-point' in c['detail'] and 'transcript' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Grandma's stated limit changes the recording format from a possible video plan to audio only and fixes the interview length at exactly 45 minutes.
The librarian's confirmation changes the venue to the community recording room and fixes the date and full time window at November 6, 2027, from 14:00 to 15:30.
Omar's hearing limitation changes the accessibility setting to an exactly 18-point printed transcript and requires the large-print-transcript commitment.
